spans.s: the state of being uninjured, AV. (cf. अ॑-जीति)
(अज्यानयस्) nom. pl. N. of certain offerings, TBr., ĀpŚr.
state of anything which is not to be hurt or overpowered, ŚBr.
not greater than (abl.), TBr.
not the oldest or best
nom. pl. of which none is the eldest (the Maruts), RV. v, 59, 6 and 60, 5
cf. अ॑-कनिष्ठ.
अ-ज्येष्ठ—वृत्ति mfn. not behaving as the eldest brother [Mn. ix, 110], or (अज्येष्ठ-वृत्ति) behaving like one who has no elder brother.
1. आज्य m. a descendant of Aja, (g. गर्गादि, q.v.)

2. आ॑ज्य n. (√ अञ्ज् Vārtt. on Pāṇ. iii, 1, 109), melted or clarified butter (used for oblations, or for pouring into the holy fire at the sacrifice, or for anointing anything sacrificed or offered), RV. x; AV.; VS. &c.
(in a wider sense) oil and milk used instead of clarified butter at a sacrifice
N. of a sort of chant (शस्त्र) connected with the morning sacrifice, AitBr.; ŚBr.; KauṣBr.
N. of the Sūkta contained in the aforesaid शस्त्र, KauṣBr.
N. of a Stotra connected with that शस्त्र, TāṇḍyaBr.
the goal in a race-course, Nir. ii, 15.
आज्य—ग्रह m. a vessel of clarified butter, KātyŚr.
N. of certain formulae, ĀpŚr.
आज्य—दोह n. v.l. for आच्या-द्˚, q.v.
v.l. for आच्या-द्˚, q.v.
आज्य—धन्वन् mfn. having the clarified butter for its bow, AitBr.
आज्य—धानी f. receptacle of clarified butter, Kauś.
आज्य—प॑ mfn. drinking the clarified butter, VS.; ŚBr.
आज्य—प॑ m. pl. a class of Manes (who are the sons of Pulastya [Mn. iii, 197 seq.] or of Kardama [VP.] and the ancestors of the Vaiśya order).
आज्य—पात्र n. a vessel for clarified butter.
आ॑ज्य—भाग (आ॑ज्य-), m. a portion of clarified butter, ŚBr.
du. (औ) the two portions of clarified butter belonging to Agni and Soma, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. &c., MBh. xiv, 722
आ॑ज्य—भाग mf(आ)n. partaking of the clarified butter, TS. ii.
आज्य—भुज् m. ‘consumer of clarified butter’, Agni, R. iii, 20, 38.
आ॑ज्य—लिप्त (आ॑ज्य-), mfn. anointed with clarified butter, ŚBr.
आज्य—लेप m. an unguent made of clarified butter, ŚāṅkhGṛ.
आज्य—वारि m. ‘sea of clarified butter’, one of the seven mythical seas, L.
आज्य—विला॑पनी f. the vessel containing the clarified butter, ŚBr.
आज्य—स्थाली f. = -पात्र above, MānŚr.; MānGṛ.
आ॑ज्य—हविस् (आ॑ज्य-), mfn. having an oblation consisting of clarified butter, ŚBr.; AitBr.
आज्य—होम m. an oblation consisting of clarified butter, Gaut.
= आज्य-होम above, ŚBr.; AitBr. &c.
